divergences.reason: The mapper floored edge progress to permille and, at zero, reported a vehicle that had entered an edge as standing on the node behind it. On a directed network that is a different place, not a conservative approximation: the vehicle cannot un-enter the edge. Measured on the WP14 job w14-d20181112-s10-r1-w17-b1-ref-s7, vehicle 4 at FleetPy position (86, 8, 0.000126) was reported as node 86; the core costed 86->39 at 574.616 s while the true cost from its position was 792.244 s, and regaining node 86 alone costs 1352.586 s. The 217.628 s gap became a 192.244 s pickup-window violation. ADR-047's own note in wp9_freeze_verify.py already recorded that this rounding is outcome-bearing, which is why H6 is re-run rather than patched in place.
divergences.recoveryImpossibleReason: The bytes H6 ran under are not recoverable. Restoring the archived pre-fix mapping.py yields 5a0cf753..., not the frozen seal. Neither does any historical state of the package: the four commits that ever touched it give 3a4f203d... (d48b115), cc9ba481... (76aafae), c3c4ec4f... (2d6791f) and 50bc6e6e... (38d517d) with bytecode, and 60c87bf5..., 328cb30f..., 5de07059... and 5de07059... without it. The H6-era package therefore existed only in an uncommitted working tree. The live tree is exactly HEAD plus the mapping.py fix: all seven other sources and all eight tracked .pyc files are byte-identical to HEAD.
divergences.sealingRuleDefect: v5's _tree_sha256 filtered excluded names with 'path.name not in excluded'. __pycache__ is a directory, so passing {'__pycache__'} excluded nothing and every tree seal hashed compiled bytecode. A seal over bytecode cannot survive a recompilation, so this seal was unverifiable after any rebuild independently of RB-WP14R-009. v6 tests the intersection of the relative path's parts, matching wp14_freeze.py, so a seal covers source only. Pinned by tests/test_wp9_freeze_v6.py::SealExcludesBytecodeTests, which asserts v5 is bytecode-sensitive and v6 is not.

purpose: freeze-receipt-v5.json is the receipt the confirmatory H6 run executed under. Two of its checks no longer hold, so it can no longer be re-verified from the working tree. Both divergences are declared here, together with the one that cannot be recovered and why, so the H6 provenance chain stays honest about what it can and cannot prove.
